Record Class MainViewSimulationTabBuilder.SimulationTabComponents

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.ether.society.ui.mainview.MainViewSimulationTabBuilder.SimulationTabComponents
Record Components:
simulationRoot - root BorderPane hosting sidebar and map stack
mapStack - layered StackPane hosting map canvas and HUD overlays
headlessDashboard - telemetry overlay shown during headless execution
notificationOverlay - floating toast notification container
colorLegend - GIS statistical color legend overlay
controlTab - sidebar tab hosting 2D/3D render and playback controls
statsTab - sidebar tab hosting live cliodynamic statistics
godModeTab - sidebar tab hosting physical perturbation injectors
Enclosing class:
MainViewSimulationTabBuilder
public static record MainViewSimulationTabBuilder.SimulationTabComponents(javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane simulationRoot, javafx.scene.layout.StackPane mapStack, HeadlessDashboardOverlay headlessDashboard, NotificationOverlay notificationOverlay, ColorLegend colorLegend, javafx.scene.control.Tab controlTab, javafx.scene.control.Tab statsTab, javafx.scene.control.Tab godModeTab) extends Record
Encapsulates the assembled JavaFX scene graph nodes produced for the Simulation Tab.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
